const mode = "read" as const;
const other = mode as "write";
const s = "ok" as const;
const t2 = s as "fail";
const n = 1 as const;
const m = n as 2;
const b = true as const;
const c = b as false;
const bad = mode as number;
enum E { A = 1, B = 2 }
const e = E.A as E.B;
const f = { x: 1 } as { y: string };
console.log(other, t2, m, c, bad, e, f);
